Raat ki qasam jab woh din ko dhaanp le
Aur din ki qasam jab woh chamak jaaye
Aur us ki qasam jis ne mard aur aurat ko paida kiya hai
Beshak tumhaari koshishein mukhtalif qism ki hain
Phir jis ne maal ata kiya aur taqwa ikhtiyaar kiya
Aur neki ki tasdeeq ki
To us ke liye hum aasaani ka intezaam kar denge
Aur jis ne bukhl kiya aur laa-parwaai barti
Aur neki ko jhutlaaya hai
Us ke liye sakhti ki raah hamwaar kar denge
Aur us ka maal kuch kaam na aaega jab woh halaak ho jaaega
Beshak hidaayat ki zimmedaari hamaare oopar hai
Aur duniya o aakhirat ka ikhtiyaar hamaare haathon mein hai
To hum ne tumhein bhadakti hui aag se daraaya
Jis mein koi na jaaega siwaaye badbakht shakhs ke
Jis ne jhutlaaya aur munh pher liya
Aur us se anqareeb saahib-e-taqwa ko mahfooz rakha jaaega
Jo apne maal ko de kar paakeezgi ka ehtemaam karta hai
Jab ke us ke paas kisi ka koi ehsaan nahin hai jis ki jaza di jaaye
Siwaaye yeh ke woh Khuda-e-Buzurg ki marzi ka talabgaar hai
Aur anqareeb woh raazi ho jaaega
